summary: Relief, on thin air. The half-day after Thanksgiving extended Wednesday's reversal: NQ added about 2.5% from the Wednesday close to 26,753, ES rose 1.6% to 7,310, and both held above their session average and their 1h trend stops. Tech led (Amazon +4%, Oracle +3.5%) with small caps joining, so the buying was broad. The VIX was crushed to 23.81, fully round-tripping the 34-plus panic. Gold closed green at 3,681 but faded from an overnight 3,712 spike and flipped its short-term stop down; crude spiked to 86.6 then gave it back to close 83.32. Volume ran light, so treat the strength as a holiday drift until Monday confirms it.

risk.note: Week ahead: Monday Nov 30 is month-end (watch rebalancing flows). The data calendar restarts with ISM manufacturing early in the week and the jobs report around Friday Dec 4; the next Federal Reserve decision is mid-December. Keep size measured until the full-volume tape confirms the bounce.

psychology: Thin days lie. A half-session on light volume can drift further than the real crowd would allow, and it is easy to read a quiet, green tape as a green light to size up into the weekend. The honest move is to keep size small, let Monday's full-volume session confirm or reject the bounce, and avoid turning a holiday drift into a conviction trade. Patience here is a position.
